name: Recent File Scanner
author: wppropress

sections.description:
Recent File Scanner helps administrators detect unauthorized file uploads by scanning plugin and theme directories for files created within a user-defined timeframe.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate it through the ‘Plugins’ menu in the admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Tools > Recent File Scanner to start scanning.
sections.faq:
Does it delete or quarantine files?

No. It only scans and reports. Future updates may add cleanup features.

Does it scan core system files?

No. It only scans themes and plugins.

short_description: Scan themes and plugins for newly created files added in the last N days. Great for detecting suspicious uploads.
